_note: User-authored contextual frames for the sacred/profane sub-probe. View 2 (Tab 2) = next-token fragments ending mid-clause; the model predicts the token after 'is'. View 3 (Tab 3) = full sentence embedding the probe in a ritual use-context; SAE features read at the probe-word token, layers 6/12/19.
_design: Per word: a neutral frame, a SACRED frame (holy ...), and a PROFANE/DEGRADED frame (polluted/tainted/molded ...). Tests whether contextual priming pulls the next-token disposition (View 2) and the SAE feature profile (View 3) toward experiential/parole content.
